purpose: Post-hoc low-frequency phase-aligned amplitude-peak timing diagnostic on the five frozen SXS cases. Approximates, but does not reproduce exactly, Bohé et al. 2017 Sec. IV.A's separate 5 M timing criterion; not a release gate.
reference_start: highest-resolution NR metadata relaxation_time on its raw clock, transformed by the fixed M omega_22=0.09 anchor
phase_alignment: Minimize RMS of unwrapped candidate-minus-NR phase over the early NR interval, after removing one constant phase. Evaluate candidate at NR time plus a single time lag. No intrinsic-parameter or amplitude fit.
published_reference: Bohé et al. 2017, arXiv:1611.03703v3, Sec. IV.A, Eq. (23): amplitude-peak lag after low-frequency phase alignment, target |delta t_peak_22|<=5 M.
interpretation: The chosen early-window phase fit is explicit and controlled, but the paper does not specify these exact window bounds. A failure signals a model issue; a pass is not paper-equivalent or domain-wide qualification.
